targets.rawSql: SELECT ((width_bucket(score, 0, 1, 20) - 1) * 0.05)::text AS score_bucket, count(*) AS tx_count FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${us_state}' = 'All' OR us_state IN (${us_state:sqlstring})) AND ('${merch}' = 'All' OR merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '10s'), count(*) / 10.0 AS tps FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('${us_state}' = 'All' OR us_state IN (${us_state:sqlstring})) AND ('${merch}' = 'All' OR merch IN (${merch:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cat_id, round(avg(fraud_flag)::numeric, 4) AS fraud_rate FROM (SELECT cat_id, fraud_flag FROM scores WHERE cat_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1000) recent GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC
SELECT extract(hour FROM created_at)::int::text AS hour_of_day, round(avg(fraud_flag)::numeric, 4) AS fraud_rate FROM scores WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
